scope: Targeted static review of Community project/board/card/task/checklist/membership/session models and selected migrations; normal card/task create-update-delete and list/bulk alternate writers; query-layer transactional boundaries, roles/API-key/session authentication, comments/custom fields/files, actions/notifications/webhooks, optimistic client updates and reconnect snapshot recovery; selected tests and acceptance assertion/step sources. Core model/controller/helper/route inventory searched for lease/heartbeat/claim/idempotency/attempt alternatives. Not every-line, Pro features, all import/duplication/migrations/user mutations, complete file/HTTP/provider/security/backend/scaling/browser/runtime certification.

lifecycle_review.create: Card insertion follows sibling repositioning; subscription/action/notification/webhooks separate; project+first-manager transaction; linked-task name/state initialization and explicit open-target completion divergence; no operation idempotency token.
lifecycle_review.select: List/search/member and included/excluded-label queries with stable endless-list cursor; discovery snapshot not dependency-ready reservation; no native blocking DAG/readiness/cycle/worker capacity authority in reviewed operation inventory.
lifecycle_review.claim: Multiple card members allowed by pair unique index; checklist assignee update via id-only query, no current-owner/revision/attempt precondition; user accounts/login sessions separate from absent execution-attempt registry.
lifecycle_review.progress: Optimistic card/client writes, checklist completion, comments/mentions, custom-field SQL upsert and generated uploaded-file IDs; no enforced ownership fence, immutable accepted-result digest or required handoff envelope.
lifecycle_review.review: Board editor/viewer access and mirrored linked task restrictions; no qualified review or accepted child/evidence gate; normal close, list retype, transfer/bulk writes assessed independently.
lifecycle_review.complete: Card isClosed changes transactionally update referencing tasks; list board/type changes lock list row and sync cards/linked tasks in transaction; no gate on closing card own checklist or accepted results, and external notifications not same transaction.
lifecycle_review.cancel: Archive/trash/reopen are record operations, no native worker stop/resume; card related-delete before row-delete, list delete reverse ordering; removes comments/actions and asynchronously cleans files with no encompassing rollback.
lifecycle_review.recover: Postgres state shared by clients; reconnect fetches bootstrap/core/current-view snapshot, not event replay or atomic global snapshot; optimistic update-failure action has no rollback handler in inspected client inventory; bounded unread queue auto-reads beyond100, webhooks fire-and-log no durable retries; scalar request/attachment IDs and local browser request queue do not fence stale attempts or server retries.
